nodes.description: Public address state variable that records the contract owner; initialized at deployment with msg.sender and used as the authority for the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable that stores the highest migration index recorded as completed.
Untrusted caller address; used to initialize owner and compared against owner inside the restricted modifier.
Public function protected by the restricted modifier that writes the supplied migration index into last_completed_migration.
uint parameter of setCompleted carrying the migration index supplied by the caller.
State-modifying write of caller-supplied data to the last_completed_migration storage slot, permitted only when the restricted modifier authorizes msg.sender.

edges.reason: The untrusted caller address msg.sender is stored into the owner state variable during construction, fixing the privileged identity of the contract.
msg.sender flows into the restricted modifier where it is compared with owner; the comparison determines whether setCompleted may execute, so caller identity governs the authorization decision.
Execution of setCompleted reaches the storage write operation that updates last_completed_migration after the restricted modifier check succeeds.
The completed parameter value flows directly into the store operation on last_completed_migration without arithmetic, so no overflow or underflow is possible for the raw assignment.
The write operation mutates the last_completed_migration state variable, linking the unsafe operation to the affected storage slot.
Because the restricted modifier gates the enclosing function on msg.sender == owner, caller identity controls whether the state write to last_completed_migration can be reached.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter completed is a transient non-core value with no independent identity; it exists only to be stored, so it is merged into the directly related unsafe write operation on last_completed_migration.
